fusions.name: Shelled In
fusions.desc: Closes a cage of shell plates around the first enemy it meets, which deals 10 damage and stuns it for 1.6 seconds. The target is [Suppressed] for 5 seconds: its auras are smothered and its abilities are out of reach.

fusions.name: Ribs Sprung Wide
fusions.desc: Springs the ribs of your shell outward as bars, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Portcullis
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Anything it holds moves 25% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Turn the Key
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying one of your afflictions. Your armour rises by 5%.
